title_zh: 美国将把阿富汗难民驱逐到巴基斯坦，尽管他们有被送回塔利班的风险
summary_zh: 一名高级政府官员告诉 NBC 新闻，特朗普政府正准备首次将数十名阿富汗移民和寻求庇护者驱逐到巴基斯坦，批评人士称此举可能会让他们面临生命危险。

title_en: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes
summary_en: Troubles at Vanke raise questions about the continued spread of the property crisis and whether the Chinese state will step in.
title_zh: 中国领先的房地产开发商报告巨额亏损，房地产困境加剧
summary_zh: 万科的麻烦引发了人们对房地产危机持续蔓延以及中国政府是否会介入的疑问。

title_en: Italy Supports Saudi Arabia Joining Fighter-Jet Program, PM Meloni Says
summary_en: The U.K., Italy and Japan have already partnered on the Global Combat Air Programme, which aims to put a new stealth fighter with supersonic capability in the skies by 2035.
title_zh: 总理梅洛尼表示，意大利支持沙特阿拉伯加入战斗机计划
summary_zh: 英国、意大利和日本已经就全球空战计划展开合作，该计划的目标是到 2035 年将具有超音速能力的新型隐形战斗机送上天空。

title_en: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
summary_en: The dictator, eager to shut out the influence of Hollywood and K-pop, has been exalting a “shock brigade” of 300,000 teens and 20-somethings drafted into flood reconstruction.
title_zh: 金正恩正在尽一切努力让朝鲜年轻人保持一致
summary_zh: 这位独裁者急于排除好莱坞和韩国流行音乐的影响，一直在赞扬一支由 30 万青少年和 20 多岁的年轻人组成的“突击队”，被征召参加洪水重建。

title_en: Germany's Economic Model Is Broken, and No One Has a Plan B
summary_en: The country is focused on exports, but China is slowing imports and U.S. tariff threats are growing. Politicians are offering few alternatives.
title_zh: 德国经济模式已被打破，没有人有备用计划
summary_zh: 该国专注于出口，但中国正在放缓进口，而美国的关税威胁正在加剧。政客们几乎没有提供任何替代方案。

title_en: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
summary_en: The Chinese foreign minister spoke by phone with Marco Rubio, the new secretary of state who has been a critic of Beijing.
title_zh: 北京表示愿意与特朗普团队，甚至是宿敌进行对话
summary_zh: 中国外交部长与一直批评北京的新任国务卿马可·卢比奥通了电话。

title_en: Scientists film deepest ever fish on seabed off Japan
summary_en: Cruising at a depth of 8,336 meters (over 27,000 feet) just above the seabed, a young snailfish has become the deepest fish ever filmed by scientists during a probe into the abyss of the northern Pacific Ocean.
title_zh: 科学家在日本海域拍摄有史以来最深的鱼类
summary_zh: 一只小蜗牛鱼在海床上方 8,336 米（超过 27,000 英尺）的深度巡航，成为科学家在北太平洋深渊探测过程中拍摄到的最深的鱼类。

title_en: Beijing promised to 'fight back' over Taiwan leader's US visit. But this time it has more to lose
summary_en: An anticipated meeting between Taiwan's President Tsai Ing-wen and US House Speaker Kevin McCarthy in California this week has sparked concerns of a repeat of the pressure campaign China launched last year when then-Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei.
title_zh: 北京承诺将对台湾领导人访美进行“反击”。但这一次失去的更多
summary_zh: 台湾总统蔡英文和美国众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡本周将在加利福尼亚州举行会晤，这引发了人们对中国去年时任众议院议长南希·佩洛西访问台北时发起的施压行动的重演。

title_en: Micron Technology: China probes US chip maker for cybersecurity risks as tech tension escalates
summary_en: China has launched a cybersecurity probe into Micron Technology, one of America's largest memory chip makers, in apparent retaliation after US allies in Asia and Europe announced new restrictions on the sale of key technology to Beijing.
title_zh: 美光科技：随着技术紧张局势升级，中国调查美国芯片制造商的网络安全风险
summary_zh: 中国对美国最大的存储芯片制造商之一美光科技发起网络安全调查，这显然是对美国在亚洲和欧洲的盟友宣布对向北京出售关键技术实施新限制的报复。

title_en: Suspected Chinese spy balloon was able to transmit information back to Beijing
summary_en: The suspected Chinese spy balloon that transited the US earlier this year was able to capture imagery and collect some signals intelligence from US military sites, a source familiar with the matter tells CNN.
title_zh: 疑似中国间谍气球能够将信息传回北京
summary_zh: 一位知情人士告诉美国有线电视新闻网，今年早些时候飞越美国的疑似中国间谍气球能够从美国军事地点捕获图像并收集一些信号情报。

title_en: China Renaissance suspends trading, delays results after founder's disappearance
summary_en: China Renaissance, a top dealmaker in the country's tech industry, said it would suspend trading of its shares and delay the release of its annual results because it still can't get in touch with its founder.
title_zh: 创始人失踪后华兴资本暂停交易并推迟公布业绩
summary_zh: 中国科技行业最大的交易撮合者华兴资本表示，由于仍无法与其创始人取得联系，因此将暂停其股票交易并推迟发布年度业绩。
